thread:
mira: FYI monitoring alerted a regional latency/503 spike for several customers hitting eu-west around 10:40Z, looks like auto-detour kicked in and traffic moved to na-west causing higher p95.
alex: Can you post a few request ids or short traces? are these from a single customer or multiple?
mira: single tenant first, then more. sample req id: req_0a1b2c3d. I grabbed a trace.
sam: quick look at routing logs: decision=auto-detour, source_pool=eu-west-prod, target_pool=na-west-prod, reason=shard_capacity_exhausted
mira: customers reporting 200ms -> 800ms latency after detour, some 401s showing up as well.
infra-bot: [autoscaler] eu-west GPU pool full at 2026-03-15T10:40:12Z, queue_depth=4821, spillover_threshold=4000, spillover_action=route_to_compatible_region
alex: 401s? that suggests auth scope / token mismatch when we cross regions. do we rewrite or preserve tokens on detour?
mira: attached small log snippet: ```route_decision: spillover -> detour=na-west reason=shard_capacity_exhausted
auth_check: incoming_token_scope=eu-west-only -> downstream_lookup=na-west -> auth_result=scope_mismatch -> 401```
sam: repro I just ran: curl to api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with header `X-Region: eu-west` and a region-scoped token. first call returned 503 from eu-west, client retried and our gateway sent to na-west which returned 401. sequence: 503 -> retry -> 401 -> client gives up.
mira: so the detour path is not translating token scopes, and clients are seeing auth failures after spillover. also noticed a lot of inflight queueing before the detour decision.
infra-bot: queue metrics snapshot: eu-west.inflight=1200, eu-west.queued=3600, avg_wait=1.8s, spillover_triggered=true
alex: thank you. action items I see: (A) immediate mitigation to avoid auth regressions for pinned/region-scoped tokens, (B) short-term config change to reduce cross-region detours for known region-scoped customers, (C) engineering fix to preserve/translate token scopes or surface a clearer retry response.
mira: customer workaround: they pinned their account to eu-west and that kept requests local, but pinning has capacity limits and we hit the pinned pool too. pinning prevented detour but increased queueing.
sam: note: pinned pools disable detour but still subject to per-tenant quotas; when pinned pool saturates, new requests queue rather than detour. that explains the long wait times customers saw without seeing detours.
oncall-infra: I'm going to enable soft-burst capacity for eu-west and adjust the eviction threshold to shed a small percentage of background jobs to free up capacity. also will add a temporary rule to not detour requests carrying region-scoped tokens for accounts in the support ticket.
mira: please also post exact changes and a timeline here so support can tell customers.
oncall-infra: will do, ETA 15m for changes. rollback plan: revert soft-burst and re-enable detour in 60m if error rate not improved.
infra-bot: mitigation_action: enable_soft_burst(eu-west)=true by oncall-infra at 2026-03-15T10:55Z
alex: longer term: engineer story to update detour path: either 1) propagate/translate token scope when routing across regions, or 2) return a deterministic non-retriable error (e.g., 409 or specific header) so clients don't blindly retry into wrong region.
sam: filing a bug and adding to eng-infra sprint board, will link to this thread and include traces + repro curl.
mira: creating a support escalation ticket with customer traces, paste link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-7382
alex: assigned eng owners: @sam (routing) and @alex (auth) to collaborate.
oncall-infra: mitigation applied, will monitor. initial metrics look better: queue_depth down ~25% and auth 401s for detour path dropped.
mira: customer updated: latency improving, they accepted the temporary mitigation. will keep them notified.
alex: follow-up engineering tasks: - ensure telemetry emits token_scope and detour_target, - add unit tests for cross-region token handling, - document behavior in support KB.
mira: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sam: noted, will update sprint ticket and post PR refs when available.
